meta.title: Read your prescription
meta.description: Take a photo of your prescription and see each medicine, when to take it and what to watch for, in English, Urdu or Sindhi.

common.comingSoon: This part is being built and will be ready in a later stage.
common.disclaimer: AI can make mistakes, especially with handwriting. Always confirm with your pharmacist or doctor.

home.heroText: Take a photo. We'll show you each medicine, when to take it, and what to watch out for, in English, Urdu or Sindhi.
home.reassure: Free to use. Your photo is read by AI and is not saved on our server.

steps.title: Take a photo of the prescription
steps.text: Fit the whole page in good light.

steps.title: Check what we read
steps.text: Compare it with your prescription and fix anything that looks wrong.

steps.title: See a simple summary
steps.text: Medicines, timings and warnings, all in one place.

pages.historyText: Prescriptions you scan will be saved only on this phone. You can delete them at any time.
pages.aboutText: We are a local pharmacy in Sindh. This tool helps you understand your prescription in your own language. Our pharmacist is always happy to check it with you in person.
pages.contactText: Call, send a WhatsApp message, or visit us at the pharmacy.
privacyPoints: Your prescription photo is sent to an AI service (Anthropic's Claude) only to read it.
We do not save your photo or prescription details on our server.
Your past scans are kept only on your own phone, and you can delete them at any time.
We never sell or share your information.
pages.privacyDraft: This is a draft. The full policy will be added before the website goes live.

scan.intro: Take a clear photo of each page. You can add up to {max} pages.
scan.uploadHint: Photos (JPG, PNG, iPhone) or a PDF
scan.maxPagesReached: You've added the most pages allowed ({max}).

camera.title: Take a photo
camera.frameHint: Fit the whole page inside the frame
camera.useCameraApp: Use the phone's camera app instead
camera.denied: We can't use the camera here. You can use your phone's camera app or upload a photo instead.

cropper.title: Crop photo
cropper.hint: Drag the corners so only the prescription is inside.

quality.tooDarkTip: Use more light, or turn on the phone's light.
quality.blurryTip: Hold the phone steady and tap the screen to focus.
quality.tooSmallTip: Move closer, but fit the whole page.
quality.canContinue: You can still continue, but the reading may have mistakes. A retake is better.

errors.unsupported: This file type can't be used. Please choose a photo (JPG, PNG) or a PDF.
errors.tooLarge: This file is too large. Please choose a file under {mb} MB.
errors.readFailed: We couldn't open this file. Please try another photo.
errors.heicFailed: We couldn't open this iPhone photo. Please take a screenshot of it and upload that instead.
errors.pdfFailed: We couldn't open this PDF. Please take a photo of the page instead.

consent.label: I understand my prescription photo will be sent to an AI service (Anthropic's Claude) to read it. It is not saved on this pharmacy's server.
consent.required: Please tick the box to continue.

apiErrors.offline: You're not connected to the internet. Check your connection and try again.
apiErrors.rate_limited: Too many scans in a short time. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
apiErrors.invalid_output: We couldn't read this prescription properly. Try again with a clearer photo, or show it to our pharmacist.
apiErrors.timeout: Reading took too long. Please check your internet and try again.
apiErrors.not_configured: The reading service is not set up yet. Please contact the pharmacy.
apiErrors.ai_failed: Something went wrong while reading. Please try again.
apiErrors.bad_request: Something went wrong with the photos. Please retake them and try again.

notRx.title: This doesn't look like a prescription
notRx.text: Please take a photo of the doctor's prescription page.

preview.title: What we read
preview.nextStage: In the next stage you'll be able to check and correct everything here before seeing the summary.
preview.poorWarning: This prescription is hard to read. To be safe, please show it to our pharmacist in person.
